name: agent-ui
description: A /workers pane of this session's child runs with a live tail, and the session's pinned asks above the prompt with their context on click.

childrenDir.title: Child run directory
childrenDir.description: Folder of child out-dirs (<dir>/<slug>/). Empty: $EZOPD_RUNTIME_DIR/kimi-children, else $TMPDIR/ez-opd/kimi-children.

panelDirs.title: Review panel directories
panelDirs.description: Comma-separated folders of review panels (<dir>/<sha>/<focus>/). Empty: <git-common-dir>/.review-panel and $TMPDIR/review-panel.

stateDir.title: State directory
stateDir.description: Folder holding asks/<session-id>. Empty: $AGENT_STATE_DIR, else the parent of session_bus_dir in the main checkout's .agent/orchestrate.local.md.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh seconds
refreshSeconds.description: How often the pane and the asks band re-read their files; clamped to 1-5.

maxAgeHours.title: Finished-run age limit (hours)
maxAgeHours.description: Finished or dead runs older than this are left out of the pane.
